result.judge_notes: pass 1 (A=with, B=without): Both answers cover every rubric point well. A adds subcategory shortcuts and gives an explicit order for the phone layout. B adds grouping of variant products and keeping the shopper's place when they press back. Neither drifts into visual styling, so the overall quality is essentially equal. | pass 2 (A=without, B=with): Both answers cover the same core problems and fixes: shrink the banner, collapse the filters, use a filter drawer on phones, go to 4 columns with spec lines on cards, and show 48 per page.
